name: docker-webmail-gui
description: Self-hosted web admin panel for docker-mailserver, with Docker access held behind a privilege-separated broker.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && (npm run dev --workspace apps/broker & npm run dev --workspace apps/server & npm run dev --workspace apps/web & wait)
scripts.pretest:e2e: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.check: npm run check:deps && npm run check:audit && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
